mainEntity.name: Multilevel B2 sertifikati IELTS nechchiga teng?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multilevel — CEFR asosidagi milliy imtihon, shuning uchun B2 sertifikati IELTS 5.5–6.5 oralig'iga to'g'ri keladi. C1 sertifikati esa IELTS 7.0–8.0 ga teng.

mainEntity.name: DTM'da maksimal ball uchun qaysi daraja kerak?

acceptedAnswer.text: OTMga kirishda amaldagi B2 yoki undan yuqori sertifikat (IELTS 5.5+, Multilevel B2+) chet tilidan maksimal ball beradi: birinchi fan bo'lsa 93.0, ikkinchi fan bo'lsa 63.0. 2026-yildan B1 sertifikat maksimalning 75% ini beradi.
According to the official ETS linking study, IELTS 7.0 corresponds to TOEFL iBT 94–101. IELTS 6.5 corresponds to TOEFL 79–93.

mainEntity.name: Is the Duolingo English Test equal to IELTS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Approximately: DET 115–120 ≈ IELTS 6.5, DET 125–130 ≈ IELTS 7.0. Always check the official Duolingo comparison tool, and note that UK visa routes and most government scholarships still require IELTS.
